title: Vapor-Liquid Equilibria of the NaCl-H2O System in the Temperature Range 300-440 C
experimental_method: Direct sampling of liquid and vapour phases from a 1-L stainless-steel autoclave with a high-pressure dilution unit, NaCl analysed by AgNO3 potentiometric titration (liquid) and Na+ electrode (vapour).
uncertainties_stated: Pressure gauge 0.1 % full scale (+-0.7 kg/cm2); liquid concentration +-1 %; vapour Na+ +-2 %; temperature ripple <0.1 C; coefficient of variation <=2.5 %.
quality_remarks: The PDF starts with page 16 of another article (K2S2O7-KHS04-V2O5 densities, end of text) which was not extracted. Text layer header lists vapour column as 'm' in places; the page image shows [%]. Basis of percent (mass) not stated. Printed K_D values were not recomputed.
not_extracted_tables: Table VI (polynomial coefficients for molten K2S2O7-KHSO4-V2O5 densities; belongs to another article)
extraction_notes: Table transcribed from the 200 dpi page image (text layer scrambled). Ditto marks for temperature filled down. Sanity: within each isotherm pressure falls as liquid concentration rises; vapour NaCl rises with temperature. No duplicate rows (420 C 292.0 and 288.9 have similar but distinct values).
needs_pass2_reason: text layer scrambled, table was transcribed from the image alone
pass2_diff: Table 1: 74 rows; every pass-2 number occurs in pass 1; pass-1-only numbers are the group temperatures filled down.
